_about: Rhythm overrides for Soulboy, measured from the 30 s iTunes previews with a numpy onset/beat analysis (spectral flux, DP beat tracker, accent periodicity at 3 vs 4 beats, off-beat position). songs.py uses tempo_measured as `tempo` and copies meter, beats_per_bar and feel. tempo_reccobeats is kept for reference.

tracks.name: Prologue
tracks.note: Spoken intro over a steady groove. Downbeat contrast 4 vs 3 = 1.19 vs 0.29; off-beat energy at the half, none at the thirds.

tracks.name: 妹妹
tracks.note: Contrast 4 vs 3 = 1.03 vs 0.28. Clear periodicity at 100.5; none at 123.6.

tracks.name: 春風吹
tracks.note: Octave ambiguity 67.5/136. At 136 lag-4 accent autocorrelation 0.40 vs -0.39 at lag 3. Could read as a 68 BPM half-time groove.

tracks.name: 每天每天
tracks.note: Strongest triplet signal: autocorrelation T/3 = 0.42, T/2 = -0.02, off-beat at about 2/3. Four dotted-quarter beats at 58 per bar; triplet pulse about 175.

tracks.name: 女人
tracks.note: Contrast 4 vs 3 = 0.81 vs 0.17. Off-beat clearly at the half.

tracks.name: 叫我怎麼說
tracks.note: Beat at 95 is clear but no accent periodicity in either grouping; 4/4 is a pop-ballad default, not measured. Feel measured: straight eighths.

tracks.name: 哪怕
tracks.note: Conflicting: downbeat contrast prefers 3 (0.96 vs 0.33) but onset autocorrelation is higher at 4 beats. Straight sixteenths. 4/4 at 127.5 is the alternative.

tracks.name: 南音
tracks.note: Weakest periodicity on the album. At 72: triplet subdivision (T/3 = 0.21, off-beat about 2/3), 4 beats per bar. 105 = 1.5 x 72, a hemiola reading of the same 12/8.

tracks.name: 我們能不能
tracks.note: Contrast 4 vs 3 = 0.62 vs 0.19. Strong half-beat subdivision. 153.6 has no periodicity; 90 (or 180) does.

tracks.name: 跳
tracks.note: Lag-4 accent autocorrelation 0.57 vs -0.28, contrast 1.37, straight sixteenths. Secondary candidate 136 (4:3) from syncopation.

tracks.name: 總結
tracks.note: Clearest 4/4 on the album: contrast 1.57 vs 0.31, lag-4 autocorrelation 0.52.

tracks.name: 趕場
tracks.note: Contrast prefers 4 at both 66 and 133.5 (octave pair). Straight eighths.

tracks.name: 等著你回來
tracks.note: At 95: contrast 0.52 vs 0.24, sixteenth syncopation. The 2/3 off-beat seen at 118.6 is a 5:4 artefact, not swing.

tracks.name: 認識你
tracks.note: Weak periodicity (clip may be mostly the spoken intro). Grouping prefers 4. Subdivision too faint to call; a laid-back swung feel can't be ruled out.
